entries.title: Psalms 5:1
segments: To the Chief Musician, for flutes. A Psalm of David. Give ear to my words, O LORD; consider my meditation.

entries.title: Psalms 5:2
segments: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God; for to You I will pray.

entries.title: Psalms 5:3
segments: My voice You shall hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning I will direct [my prayer] to You, and I will look up.

entries.title: Psalms 5:4
segments: For You [are] not a God that enjoys wickedness; nor shall evil dwell with You.

entries.title: Psalms 5:5
segments: The foolish shall not stand in Your sight. You hate all doers of iniquity.

entries.title: Psalms 5:6
segments: You shall destroy those who speak lies; the LORD will despise the bloody and deceitful man.

entries.title: Psalms 5:7
segments: But I, in the abundance of Your grace, I will come [into] Your house; I will worship in Your fear toward Your holy temple.

entries.title: Psalms 5:8
segments: Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness, because of my enemies; make Your way straight before my face.

entries.title: Psalms 5:9
segments: For [there is] no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is wickedness; their throat [is] an open grave; they flatter with their tongue.

entries.title: Psalms 5:10
segments: Hold them guilty, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against You.

entries.title: Psalms 5:11
segments: But let all who put their trust in You rejoice; let them always shout for joy, because You defend them. And let those who love Your name be joyful in You.

entries.title: Psalms 5:12
segments: For You; O LORD, will bless the righteous; with favor You will surround him as [with] a shield.
